name: Man's Best Friends

gist.Orthos, the Loyal Guard Dog: When he summons a Loyal creature he summons a second from hand for free.
gist.Ingo, Investor of Evil: Gold for every creature that lands.
gist.Alice, the Puppeteer Girl: Hits per creature that stayed on her board.
gist.Loyal Labradoodle: All damage to her creatures is reduced, more for each Loyal creature on the board.
gist.Loyal Shepherd: When you kill a Loyal creature, a different one from the deck takes its place.
gist.Loyal Terrier: When a Loyal creature dies, it bites one of your targets.
gist.Loyal Bone Dog: Discarded from hand to revive a Loyal creature that just died.
gist.Loyal Hountriever: Draws a card for each Loyal creature summoned.
gist.Loyal Pinpom: Brings another Loyal creature with it.
gist.Loyal Rottweiler: Swaps itself for any Loyal creature from the deck.
gist.Book of Doom: Gold for small hits on many targets.
gist.Alchemy: Ability: draws from her Potion Deck.

plan: A pack. Orthos and the Pinpom put two or three dogs down a turn, the Hountriever draws for each, and once a Labradoodle is among five dogs a sweeper barely scratches them. The Shepherd replaces what you kill, the Terrier bites when a dog dies, the Bone Dog brings it back, and Alice counts the pack every turn. The dogs are individually tiny; the Labradoodle is the card that makes the pack hard to remove.

looks.mid: Seven dogs around a Labradoodle; Alice hitting hard.
looks.late: A pack you have swept twice, still seven strong.

opening.tell: Three small dogs and no Labradoodle yet.
opening.why: Before the Labradoodle one sweep kills the pack outright; after it, sweepers do a fraction.

midgame.tell: A Labradoodle stands in a pack of six.
midgame.why: Take the Labradoodle with Dark Gear (The Yeeting is a kill and lets the Shepherd replace it) and the sweep works again.

crisis.tell: Alice hits for seven dogs each turn and a Terrier bites for every dog that dies.
crisis.why: Shield Alice's hit and freeze her; killing dogs one by one only feeds Terrier and Shepherd.

endgame.tell: Her hand is empty and the pack is four.

opening.board: Anni lays out three dogs in a straight line.

midgame.board: A Labradoodle in a pack of six: your sweep would scratch them.
You Yeet the Labradoodle; the Shepherd fetches another dog and a Bone Dog revives it.

options.text: Steal it next time; freeze Orthos

midgame.board: Her own Dark Gear finds nothing to steal.

options.text: A dead card for her: take the Labradoodle

crisis.board: A Terrier bites each time a dog dies.

options.text: Kill none, or all at once

crisis.board: Book of Doom pings your three heroes.
